BUSINESS STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Cash Books is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Cash Books with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Cash Books never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Books.
   D. Treat Cash Books as rumours only.

2. Which statement about Trial Balance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Trial Balance as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Trial Balance.
   C. Say Trial Balance never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Trial Balance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Ignore prices in shops

4. Which statement about Financial Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Financial Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Financial Markets never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Financial Markets as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Financial Markets.

5. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Replace the compass rose

6. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Destroying road signs

7. Which statement about Procurement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Procurement never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Procurement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Procurement.
   D. Treat Procurement as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.
   B. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.
   C. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about The Ledger is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat The Ledger as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing The Ledger.
   C. Say The Ledger never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain The Ledger with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Consumer and Investor Protection is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Consumer and Investor Protection never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Consumer and Investor Protection.
   C. Explain Consumer and Investor Protection with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Consumer and Investor Protection as rumours only.

11. Which statement about Methods of Price Determination is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Methods of Price Determination.
   B. Say Methods of Price Determination never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Methods of Price Determination as rumours only.
   D. Explain Methods of Price Determination with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   C. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.

13. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Mombasa
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nakuru

14. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Marketing as rumours only.
   B. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.
   D. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.

15. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.
   D. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.

16. Which statement about Savings and Investments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Savings and Investments.
   B. Explain Savings and Investments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Savings and Investments as rumours only.
   D. Say Savings and Investments never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Types of Business Ownership and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Methods of Price Determination and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Entrepreneurship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Procurement and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Marketing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain The Ledger and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
